 Houston Rockets TST Best Bets: November 20, 2026
 By Timothy Hessen Nov 20, 2026 • 3:54 pm
 Share via facebook Share via X Share via email NBA Cup group play takes center stage tonight, and the Rockets-Nuggets matchup could shake up West Group A. Houston is 1-1 in group play, while Denver is looking to stay unbeaten and avenge its earlier loss to the Rockets.
 The Lakers can strengthen their position in West Group C and move closer to the knockout rounds with a win over Sacramento, which needs a victory to stay alive.

 First Pick:  Sacramento Kings +14 over the Los Angeles Lakers 
 Rundown: The Kings are in a rough stretch, but 14 points is a lot to give them against a Lakers team whose offense has cooled off. Los Angeles scored 97 in Wednesday’s loss to Utah after putting up at least 116 in each of its previous nine games.
 The Lakers are also just 1-4 against the spread as favorites of at least 7.5 points. Sacramento has dropped seven straight, but rookie Darius Acuff Jr. is coming off a 36-point performance, and the Kings have scored at least 107 in two of their last three. I’ll take the points and hope they can keep this one within reach.
 Second Pick:  Denver Nuggets -1.5 over the Houston Rockets 
 Isaiah J. Downing-Imagn Images
 Nov 16, 2026; Denver, Colorado, USA; Denver Nuggets center Nikola Jokic (15) passes the ball as Phoenix Suns guard Luke Kennard (8) guards in the fourth quarter at Ball Arena.
 Rundown: Houston is missing all three of its injured centers, a tough spot against Denver’s size and physicality. That could leave the Rockets scrambling to find answers when the Nuggets run their offense through Jokic, especially late in a close game.
 Denver has won five of its last seven and just beat Boston at home. Houston is 12-4, but three of its four losses have come on the road. At this short number, I like the Nuggets to take care of business in Denver.
